name: Is a building permit required for garage conversions?

mainEntity.name: Is a building permit required for garage conversions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all garage conversions require building permits plus electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits to ensure the space meets current residential standards for habitability and safety.
